providers.title: Symmetric threshold functions
providers.scope: The sign of prod_(j in J) (t(x) - j - 1/2), t the number of +1 coordinates, has average sensitivity n 2^(1-n) sum_(j in J) binom(n-1, j).
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Sharpness of the order d sqrt(n)
providers.scope: For n >= 17 and 1 <= d <= 1 + sqrt(n-1)/3, a symmetric threshold function of degree d has average sensitivity at least d sqrt(n)/6.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: One-sided coupling (OpenAI)
providers.scope: Equally distributed U, V with variance sigma^2 and V - U <= a satisfy E(U - V)^2 <= 8 a sigma.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Hilbert-Schmidt and block norms
providers.scope: The Hilbert-Schmidt norm is basis independent and splits over the blocks of an orthogonal decomposition; entries are bounded by the operator norm.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: The weighted grading
providers.scope: The weighted degree increments have dimensions binom(n, k), the centred grading has squared Hilbert-Schmidt norm nN/4, and coordinate multiplications connect only equal or adjacent grades.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Edges from the anticommutator (OpenAI)
providers.scope: For every positive weight and sign function h, the number of ordered edges on which h is constant is at most 2 ||MH + HM||_HS^2.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: The asymptotic Gotsman-Linial conjecture (OpenAI)
providers.scope: A polynomial threshold function of degree at most d on {-1,1}^n has average sensitivity at most 8 d sqrt(n).
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Noise sensitivity in Fourier terms
providers.scope: NS_eta(f) = (1/2) sum_S (1 - (1 - 2 eta)^|S|) fhat(S)^2, nondecreasing in eta on [0, 1/2].
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Noise sensitivity of threshold functions (OpenAI)
providers.scope: A polynomial threshold function of degree at most d has noise sensitivity at most 8 sqrt(2) d sqrt(eta).
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review
